_real_world.class: Guizhou WS-21 (also reported as WS-13X) low-bypass afterburning turbofan
_real_world.variant_scope: WS-21 as fitted to the early-production carrier-based J-35 (interim powerplant pending the WS-19)
public_equipment: WS-21, ~93.2 kN (20,950 lbf) afterburning thrust, derivative/stretch of the WS-13E, first close-up imagery Dec 2025 (Defence Security Asia, Wikipedia)

_provenance.modeling_note: Interim engine for the carrier-based J-35 per the task's explicit instruction (the OOB page's J-35 Engines row lists 'WS-21 (interim, 87-93 kN AB each)'; WS-19 is the intended production engine and is not separately modeled unless the branch is exercised — see CSG_CN_WS-19 companion record). No PRC official disclosure exists; all figures are Tier C (Wikipedia, Defence Security Asia, migflug), cross-confirmed across 3 independent web sources for the afterburning thrust figure. No public dry/military thrust, SFC, or bypass ratio figures exist; those fields are engineering_estimate proxies patterned on the repo CSG_US_F414-GE-400 template's structure, scaled to this engine's smaller/lower-bypass class as described qualitatively by Defence Security Asia (~60 kN dry thrust estimate, bypass ratio 0.4-0.5 estimate) and by analogy to the WS-13 family lineage.

engine.mil_thrust_n.note: Defence Security Asia estimates ~60 kN dry thrust for the WS-21; no PRC official figure exists

engine.ab_thrust_n.note: 93.2 kN (20,950-21,000 lbf) afterburning thrust, consistent across Wikipedia and migflug, both citing the same imagery-era assessment; OOB page range 87.2-93.2 kN, upper bound used

engine.sfc_mil.note: engineering_estimate patterned on the repo F414-GE-400 template's sfc_mil, nudged up slightly reflecting the WS-13-family lineage's generally less fuel-efficient dry cruise vs Western engines of this thrust class; no public figure

engine.sfc_ab.note: engineering_estimate, same basis as sfc_mil; no public figure

engine.bypass_ratio.note: Defence Security Asia's 'estimated 0.4-0.5' bypass ratio for the WS-21, midpoint 0.45 used
